summary: Implemented the unknown-total speed indicator in rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, and CHANGELOG.md, as specified. Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False), a static render_speed method, and a speed branch in render; module-level track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column; Progress.track now leaves the total None for unsized iterables instead of raising, with task_total declared Optional[float] up front. Tests: removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track and added test_task_progress_column_speed. CHANGELOG has the new Added line. Not verified: I did not run tests, mypy, or black, per the instructions; I only checked for runs of three or more blank lines in the edited Python files. Nothing is committed.
